body_html:
The Craft Wedge Unit turns an open lobby or breakout area into a flexible, collaborative space. As a non-handed modular component, its geometric wedge shape lets you build curved and angled arrangements that flow with the room, then reconfigure them whenever the space needs to change. Fully upholstered and durable, it is at home in school commons, healthcare waiting areas, and busy office breakout zones.

Features

  • Non-handed modular wedge that reconfigures freely within a Craft layout
  • Geometric shape for curved, angled, and open seating arrangements
  • Pairs with other Craft seating shapes and tables to create casual meeting spaces
  • Standard 1.5" tall nylon glides; optional dual-wheel carpet (C107) or hard-floor (C107R) casters
  • Available in all Grade 1 seating textiles, Luxhide, and graded-in or GPM textiles
  • GREENGUARD Gold certified for low chemical emissions and indoor air quality

Specifications

Overall 40"W x 17.75"D x 17.5"H with a 17.5" seat height and a 37 lb weight. Rated for an eight-hour single shift for users up to 275 lbs, and backed by a 2-year limited warranty. Made in Canada.
